title: Centralize in-force predicate; rejected decisions stop enforcing
context: Multiple sites (veto, conformance, strictgate, etc.) each inlined their own weaker in-force check. REJECTED decisions kept blocking commits and injecting warnings everywhere. No escape without hand-editing decisions/*.json. Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Extract isInForce() to core/topics.ts; all six guard sites use it. Excludes: superseded, REJECTED, window-closed. Keeps proposed drafts as in-force (advisory signal only; tripwire rules prevent blocks).
consequences: REJECTED decisions stop enforcing consistently across all six sites
Window-closed decisions no longer block commits
Single audited source of truth eliminates drift between sites
Rejected state now truly un-stickable without hand-edits
alternatives_rejected: Fix each site independently — leaves inconsistency; future changes miss sites
Make isInForce stricter (exclude proposed drafts) — loses advisory signal needed for intent discovery
Only fix veto gate — problem exists everywhere; fragile to maintenance bugs
